L113: # Military Undergraduate Tuition
L114: 
L115: ## Military Undergraduate Tuition
L116: 
L117:   * 【58†How to Use VA Educational Benefits】
L118: ## Tuition and Fees
L119: 
L120: * * *
L121: 
L122: For non-nursing undergraduate degree programs only.
L123: 
L124:   * Military Tuition: $250 per credit
L125:   * TECEP Exams
L126:     * Lower Level TECEP Exams (100-200): $54 per credit
L127:     * Upper Level TECEP Exams (300-400): $81 per credit
L128:   * Application fee*: $50
L129:   * Graduation Audit Fee: $98
L130: 
L131: ^{* (currently waived for military and veteran students)}
L132: The Military Tuition rate is offered to Active Duty, Air/Army National Guard, and Reserve Servicemembers, their spouses and dependents, and Department of Defense Civil Service employees.
L133: 
L134: Tuition is paid at the time of course registration. Text and materials are extra and cost varies per course. Students can order textbooks and course materials directly from:
L135: Barnes & Noble College
L136: Order online: 【59†bncvirtual.com/tesu†bncvirtual.com】
L137: Order by phone: 800-325-3252
L138: VA Chapter 31 and Veteran Readiness and Employment (VR&E) Students: 【60†Use a Voucher†bncvirtual.com】
L139: ### Edison Accelerate Fee
L140: 
L141: * * *
L142: 
L143: Military Rate: $3,468
L144: 
L145: NOTE: The Edison Accelerate fee applies to military students who have not earned at least 12 credits towards an associate degree or 24 credits towards a bachelor’s degree in online (OL), Guided Study (GS), Accelerated (AC), TECEP (TE) or e-Pack (EP) courses. For all certificate programs, students must earn at least 50% of their credits directly from TESU.
L146: If a student pays either Edison Accelerate fee or does not graduate within 15 months, they will be required to pay an additional Edison Accelerate fee.
L147: 
L148: Students with questions about the Edison Accelerate fee are encouraged to speak with their TESU advisor.
L149: ## Important Note for Military Students
L150: 
L151: * * *
L152: 
L153:   * Military students who enroll in the Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) degree program will pay the 【61†nursing program tuition rate】.
L154:   * Military students who enroll in the graduate-level degree programs will pay the 【62†graduate tuition rate】 or 【63†MBA tuition】 (if enrolled in the MBA program).
L155: In accordance with VA guidance, Thomas Edison State University places all VA students no longer qualifying for contracted military tuition programs into the Per Credit Tuition Plan (PCTP). Under this plan, undergraduate tuition will be assessed on a per-credit basis.
L156: 
L157: 【64†View Undergraduate Tuition for Non-Military and Veteran Students】
L158: Whether or not a student will have out-of-pocket expenses depends on which chapter of the GI Bill they are using and whether they are covered at 100% or not. Some chapters are designed to have students pay for tuition up front and receive reimbursement from the VA following certification. Other chapters do not require students to pay for tuition up front and the tuition is sent from the VA to the University following certification.
L159: If you have specific questions about your educational benefit, please contact the U.S. Department of Veteran Affairs directly at 888-442-4551.
L160: NOTE: All tuition and fees listed here were approved on June 12, 2026, by the Board of Trustees of TESU and are effective August 2026 term. Tuition and fees are subject to change.
L161: 
L162:   * 【65†Important Note for Using Your Service’s Tuition Assistance】
L163: Students attending Thomas Edison State University are expected to participate and fully engage in all academically related activities. Examples of these activities include making submissions to online discussion boards, communicating within the class lounge forum, dialoguing with mentors within the private mentor forum, submitting assignments and completing exams and quizzes when due. Students must review course calendars for the timing and types of submissions expected.

L91: Qualified online military students and military spouses (【15†as defined by Liberty University】) are eligible to receive a discount on the cost of tuition upon successfully verifying their military status.
L92: ## 2026-2027 Academic Year
L93: 
L94: ### Undergraduate
L95: 
L96: For undergraduate programs (Certificate, Associates, and Bachelors), the tuition rate is $250 per credit hour, which is the Tuition Assistance cap for Army, Air Force and Space Force, Navy, Marines, and Coast Guard.
L97: 
L98: ### Graduate
L99: 
L100: The tuition rate for graduate online programs (graduate certificates and master’s degrees) is $310 per credit hour.
L101: ### Doctoral
L102: 
L103: When you complete a graduate degree through Liberty – including the nested 21-hour executive certificates – and you continue your studies into a doctoral program within 2 academic years of graduation, you will receive a reduced tuition rate of just $395 per credit hour.
L104: The $395 tuition rate only applies to active service members, eligible veterans, and spouses who are new to a doctoral program in Fall 2020 or after. DoW employees are only eligible for the discounted tuition rate for the executive certificates, Ed.S., Ed.D. and D.Min.: Pastoral Counseling programs. Degrees awarded in passing do not qualify.
L105: 
L106: Note that there are some program exclusions. For questions about your specific program of study, see 【16†Student Financial Services】.
L107: ## Criteria
L108: 
L109: Students who meet any of the below criteria may qualify for the discounted online military tuition rate:
L110: 
L111:   * Active Duty
L112:   * Reserve/National Guard
L113:   * Veterans/Retirees
L114: 
L115:   * Spouses of Service Members and Veterans/Retirees
L116:   * Current Department of War Employees
L117: ### Military Children
L118: 
L119: We recognize the sacrifice military members and their families make. As a thank-you, we now offer a 15% discount off our regular full- or part-time tuition rates for new online students, regardless of age, whose parent(s) served honorably in the military.*
L120: 
L121: * * *
L122: ## Eligibility and Important Policies
L123:   * Service members/veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces qualify after basic training has been completed (as defined in 10 U.S.C. § 101(a)(4)). State Guard does not qualify.
L124:   * Veterans must have a Character of Service that is: Honorable, Under Honorable Conditions or General.
L125:   * A 【15†military spouse is defined by Liberty University】 as a husband or wife currently in a state-sanctioned marriage to a current service member or veteran, both of whom are natural-born members of the opposite sex.
L126:   * If you apply to a new program, change degree levels, or break enrollment, you will be required to resubmit documentation that meet the current eligibility requirements.
L127:   * The discount is only awarded once acceptable ID.me verification and/or supplemental documentation is received and reviewed by the Office of Military Affairs. Benefits are not awarded retroactively.
L128:   * ID.me verification must be received for military children during the first semester of their current program.
L129:   * Students must be pursuing an online degree program at the Certificate, Associate’s, Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctoral level. Students enrolled in a Residential program or the Willmington School of the Bible do not qualify.
L130:   * If your discharge does not meet the criteria for our military benefits and you feel your situation warrants a special review by our office, please provide a written explanation of your circumstances (including the DD-214 with character of service listed, supporting documentation, and a brief essay) to be reviewed by the Office of Military Affairs for consideration. You may email your request with documentation attached to LUOMilitary@liberty.edu.
L131: The Office of Military Affairs reserves the right to deny or approve appeals based on a comprehensive review of all documentation submitted.
L132: ## How to Apply?
L133: 
L134: If you believe you qualify for any of these benefits, please review the information on our 【17†LUO Military Benefits】 guide to apply.
L135: 
L136: Once approved, the benefits are automatically applied to the account within 3-5 business days of enrollment in course(s). You may verify your charges have updated accordingly when you complete 【4†Financial Check-In】 each semester.
L137: 
L138: * * *
L139: *Some exclusions apply. This cannot be combined with other discounts. The 15% Military Child Discount is subject to the 【18†Financial Aid General Scholarship Rule Policy】.
L140: 
L141: GI Bill® is a registered trademark of the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). More information about education benefits offered by VA is available at the official U.S. government website at 【19†https://www.benefits.va.gov/gibill†www.benefits.va.gov】.

You may owe a portion of your tuition to the university and a portion to your military branch.
L135: Before dropping or withdrawing from a course, please contact your military education counselor or education services officer to determine how it could impact your Military Tuition Assistance and potential repayment obligations.
L136:   2. Active-Duty Military students dropping within the first two weeks of classes or withdrawing after the second week through 60% of the course are subject to the refunding schedule above. However, if a student dropped due to a military service obligation, they may be eligible to file a petition for an exception to the refunding policy. Please see your Academic Advisor or One-Stop Specialist for assistance with the petition process.

L102: ## How to Use Your Education Benefits
L103: 
L104: Committed to serving those who have served our nation, our team of experts with military experience will be with you every step of the way. Explore common questions others in the military community have asked and see how UMass Global can help you achieve your education and life goals.
L105: 
L106: ## Frequently Asked Questions
L107: 
L108: ### General
L109: #### [Button: What are the top degree programs for military and veteran students? ]
L110: 
L111: Although choosing the right degree program depends on your unique goals, there are 【50†military-friendly pathways】. Those pursuing a bachelor’s may consider 【51†psychology】, 【52†criminal justice】 or even a customizable degree like 【53†applied studies】. Popular grad programs include our 【54†MBA】 or 【55†master’s in leadership】, which UMass Global specifically designed to transfer in military training.
L112: #### [Button: Does UMass Global give college credit for military experience? If so how much? ]
L113: 
L114: Yes. UMass Global awards transfer credit for military experience and training using American Council on Education (ACE) guidelines.
L115: For undergraduate programs, students receive 6 credits for military service, with the opportunity to earn additional credits based on ACE recommendations for military coursework and training. These credits may apply toward your general education, major, or emphasis area depending on eligibility.
L116: For select graduate programs (including MAOL, MS in Human Resources, Master of Healthcare Administration, and Master of GIS and Data Analytics), eligible service members may receive up to 6 transfer credits for military schooling. This benefit is available to qualified Active Duty, Reserve, National Guard, retired, and prior service members who meet rank and training requirements.
L117: To maximize your transfer credit, UMass Global evaluates your Joint Services Transcript (JST) or equivalent military records during the admissions process.
L118: ### Military and Veteran Education Benefits
L119: 
L120: #### [Button: How do I apply for veteran or military college benefits? ]
L121: 
L122: You’ll first work with the VA to determine the benefits you are eligible for, then 【56†submit your request†www.va.gov】 through their system. It generally takes 30 days to receive a decision and certificate of eligibility (COE) from the VA. Submit this document 【49†upon applying】 to maximize your education benefit at UMass Global.
L123: #### [Button: How do I use my VA benefits? ]
L124: 
L125: The VA has it’s own process for leveraging and tracking fund requests and disbursements. If you signed up for direct deposit, then they will pay directly to your bank account 7 to 10 days after you verify enrollment with UMass Global. 【57†View all VA education benefits FAQs†www.va.gov】.
L126: #### [Button: Will my VA benefits cover my entire education cost? ]
L127: 
L128: If you’re eligible for 100% of Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits, the VA will cover the full cost of your tuition and fees up to the current national maximum amount. To determine your allowance, multiply the percentage of benefits you’re eligible for by this number. 【58†Get current rates†www.va.gov】 to calculate yours.
L129: #### [Button: Do I qualify for financial aid while still receiving VA benefits? ]
L130: 
L131: Yes. If you need to supplement financing over the national maximum amount for VA education benefits, you can still apply for scholarships and federal funding through our  【59†financial aid resources】 . Your One Stop specialist will help you with the best options for you and your family.
